## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (or it only changes copy, styling or layout and is labelled `skip-tests`), and coverage stays at 80% or more
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` (or there's nothing user-facing and it's labelled `skip-changelog`)
- [ ] UI changes work in light mode, dark mode and with an accent colour other than Neutral, at the 960px minimum window width, and `npm run lint:design` passes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real personal data in code, tests, fixtures, screenshots or this description
- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/rbaskam/PRism/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks) pass locally
